scope: uv.lock Python 3.11 resolution as audited in ci-artifacts/production-wave (245 locked resolutions, 184 audited packages, pip-audit 2.10.1)
method: Every finding was re-derived from primary sources on 2026-09-28: PyPI JSON metadata (ci-artifacts/mission-20260928/advisories/*.json), pypa/advisory-database YAML (fetched via GitHub API for PYSEC-2026-2132), osv.dev records (PYSEC-2026-2447 fetched; CVSS4.0 5.2 AV:L), plus literal greps over src/ and tests/ recorded below. No advisory is suppressed and no ignore file is added.

findings.summary: pre-authentication code injection via malicious model repository when trust_remote_code=true on the Chroma server collections API
reachability_evidence: sole chromadb construction is the embedded local client: src/nexus_ai_agent/features/rag.py:184 (chromadb.PersistentClient(path=settings.chroma_db_path)); no server endpoint, no tenant/collection HTTP surface is exposed by this application
findings.mitigation: embedded-client usage only; keep it that way (any future Chroma server deployment re-opens this finding)
findings.upgrade_cost: no fixed release listed by the advisory at audit time

findings.summary: missing tenant authorization validation on Chroma server collections API
reachability_evidence: no Chroma server is started or exposed by src/ (see PYSEC-2026-311 evidence); the vulnerability class requires an authenticated multi-tenant server API
findings.upgrade_cost: no fixed release listed at audit time

findings.summary: authenticated code injection via trust_remote_code with UPDATE_COLLECTION permission
reachability_evidence: no server deployment, no collection UPDATE path, no trust_remote_code literal (0 grep matches)
findings.upgrade_cost: no fixed release listed at audit time

reachability_evidence: grep over src/ shows no SimpleRBACAuthorizationProvider usage and no Chroma server configuration at all
findings.upgrade_cost: no fixed release listed at audit time

findings.summary: command injection in click.edit() from an unprivileged account
reachability_evidence: grep -rn 'click.edit' src/ tests/ scripts/ -> 0 matches: the vulnerable API is not called by this application
findings.blocked_by: core dependency gTTS (pyproject.toml:15 'gTTS>=2.5,<3'); PyPI metadata for gTTS 2.5.4 requires_dist includes 'click<8.2,>=7.1', which conflicts with the 8.3.3 fix version (captured in ci-artifacts/mission-20260928/advisories/gTTS.json)
findings.mitigation: not-reachable evidence above; upgrade path requires gTTS releasing a click>=8.3 compatible version or replacing gTTS
findings.upgrade_cost: dependency resolution conflict; tracked, not waived

findings.summary: pickle-based cache deserialization; arbitrary code execution when an attacker with cache-directory write access is read from
reachability_evidence: grep -rn 'diskcache' src/ -> 0 matches: the application never imports diskcache; it arrives transitively (chromadb dependency tree)
exploitation requires an attacker that can already write into this process's cache directory, which is a local privileged position separate from any remote surface
findings.mitigation: transitive-only presence; revisit if diskcache ever becomes a direct dependency or if cache directories become attacker-writable
findings.upgrade_cost: no fixed release listed at audit time

notes: Status vocabulary: FIXED / MITIGATED / ACCEPTED_WITH_EVIDENCE / NOT_REACHABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE / BLOCKED / UNVERIFIED. 'NOT_REACHABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE' is per-finding and revocable: the grep evidence and usage constraint are recorded so any architectural change re-opens the finding instead of silently inheriting the old verdict.
